final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) as player_count FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), stats AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) as total_players, AVG(player_count) as avg_player_count FROM country_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT cc.player_count, CAST(cc.player_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_players as share, cc.player_count - s.avg_player_count as excess FROM country_counts cc, stats s WHERE cc.player_count > s.avg_player_count) SELECT SUM(player_count) as total_above_avg, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
